reviews_h2: What people are saying about the tree service

reviews.author: Kate Avello
reviews.text: Reece and his crew are phenomenal! We had 3 large trees right next to our home removed. They worked quickly and took such care in all that they did, including clean up. They left our yard looking better than it was before. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Vincent Vecera
reviews.text: I had a ~180 year old white oak very close to my house, with the crown entirely covering the house. The tree was in the backyard which is around thirty feet down from the street level with no clear access. Just a profoundly challenging tree. Reece had trimmed it once before and did a brilliant job, but it was time for the tree to go entirely. Reece is a tree genius. His removal was methodical, careful, and effective. His crew worked strenuously and left my backyard much nicer than they found it. This was about as technically challenging and demanding of a tree as you could imagine. And it's gone. I couldn't be more grateful. Reece is a person of unimpeachable integrity and unparalleled skill. Extraordinary work.

reviews.author: Helen Atkins
reviews.text: Reece is careful, does an amazing job and helps not only cut back and cut down trees and bushes, but helps balance your yard to make the overall look of it wonderful. Very reasonable cost for the very hard work that goes into what he does and he cleans up every leaf and branch off the ground before leaving.

reviews.author: robert montgomery
reviews.text: Excellent job raising and pruning my 2 large Crepe Myrtle’s in my front yard as well as some light work in the backyard. The crew was very friendly and attention to detail in their trimming really opened up the front yard. Great job of cleaning up after the job was complete.

reviews.author: Mike Smith
reviews.text: As property owner and having had past experience working for the city of Portland parks tree service crew, my evaluation brings depth of knowledge to this review. With that in mind I have rated Master's Touch five stars. They took one of the most challenging forested yards with years of neglect and turned it into a "park like" look with amazing curb appeal. They left the best trees to balance the yard and view and at the same time trimmed them and extracted the dead limbs giving the trees the best opportunity for health. Seriously they deserve 5 stars and I would recommend them to anyone!! THANK YOU MASTER'S TOUCH, YOU GUYS ARE AWESOME!!!

reviews.author: Ashley Hilbish
reviews.text: Reece and his crew did an above and beyond job removing over 10 trees from our property. Working with his team was a breath of fresh air, they truly care for the properties they are working in as if they were their own. From expert guidance through the process to future planning, prompt communication and timely arrival, it's rare that you get all of those things from one business. They truly offer excellency in everything they do and most importantly, take pride in their work. Like all things, you do get what you pay for, but they were more than fair and competitive. The best part is that we were able to help the community with firewood, large sections of trees for mills and more - there was no waste! We were so pleased and would absolutely hire Masters Touch again.

reviews.author: Kaylee O'Neill
reviews.text: Reece and his crew are INCREDIBLE, truly incredible! We will never use another arborist as long as we live in Lynchburg (Reece, you're never allowed to retire, haha). They took down a monster of a tree with several branches over our house...and left it unscathed! Such remarkable skill and acumen! Not only did they do the tree cutting with care, they left our yard looking squeeky clean and the wood in a beautifully organized pile. I'd leave 10 stars if I could! Thanks again!

reviews.author: Melissa Du Plessis
reviews.text: Professional, exceptionally skilled, considerate, hard working, reasonably priced, true masters of their field. We had 8 massive 100 ft. plus trees on our property very near to our home. They were in various states of decay and damage. Somehow Reece Kincaid and his team masterfully and systematically took them down. Not only was our surrounding property not damaged, but they were able to save some smaller Dogwoods growing at the bases. They cleaned up ALL the debris and all our beds, driveway and trimmed a few more trees for good measure. Not a twig left to tell the tale. It was a very complicated and dangerous job but their level of skill and expertise put us at ease. We cannot recommend Masters Touch led by the wonderful Mr. Reece Kincaid enough. He treats the trees, his team, you and your property with respect and care. Our yard is transformed from dark and dangerous to light and full of possibilities. We could not be more pleased or impressed. Absolutely excellent all round!

reviews.author: Brittany Biggerstaff
reviews.text: Extremely wonderful and professional team! When we called Reece, he came out in a timely manner to assess the situation and was back early the next morning with his crew. Can't begin to thank them enough!

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.text: I cannot use enough superlatives to describe Reece and Master's Touch Tree Service. Truly amazing, both the work they do and the people they are. There is a reason he has a waiting time and it is because there is no one like him. He was on time, he did his job superbly, he knew what he was doing and my yard looks amazing. Worth every single penny. Plus, he cleaned up perfectly when he left. This business is the epitome of what ethics, hard work and skill can do for you. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Bethany Dannelly
reviews.text: Reece, Rob, and Nathan were fantastic! They are personable, hard working, efficient, and thorough. When Reece and I were discussing an estimate on the work I needed done, he told me that he always tries to leave homes in better shape than when he showed up. He held true to his word. They did extensive cleaning everywhere they worked and really helped my yard become more presentable. I also had a very short window of time to get the trees removed and trimmed due to other pending house repairs, and Reece went out of his way to fit me into his schedule. I highly recommend Masters Touch Tree Services!

reviews.author: Steve Edwards
reviews.text: Just last week Reece and his crew worked on our yard. They spent 3 days taking down 2 trees and thinning out several others. Leading up to the job, both Reece and Tammy were very professional, courteous. They laid out a plan and were clear on the cost. When it came time to do the job, there was nothing but an excellent job done. The guys were helpful, worked great as a team and by the end of the job our yard looked better than it did before they got started. I can't speak highly enough for Masters Touch Tree Services. We certainly will be calling them again soon to do more work.

reviews.author: Josh Bergman
reviews.text: Reece Kincaid and his crew did an excellent job removing dead trees from our property. He is very knowledgeable and conducted work in a safe manner. Also very polite and left the property tidy. Wood was cut to wood-stove length and stacked. This is the second time we have had Master's Touch Tree Service work on our trees, and we will be definitely calling them again in the future!

reviews.author: Cassie Petersen
reviews.text: Master's Touch Tree Services did an excellent job on our project. They took down 9 trees total for us, one of which was extremely close to our house. Reece Kincaid (owner) and his team of hard working guys completed the work in a timely manner for a great price. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Paula Perdieu
reviews.text: Reece and team did an amazing job in our yard, I can’t get over how much better it looks. They have it all: return your calls and call if any delays, do great work in a timely manner, friendly, polite, go above and beyond for their customers. I will definitely be using them for future tree service.

reviews.author: Ryan McLennan
reviews.text: Recently moved to the area and needed a couple trees taken down in backyard. There were other trees needing trimming and I have some large areas of wooded property that has essentially been unusable. I contacted Reece for help. He and his crew were quick to give an estimate and then to do the work. They gave a fair price, but then went above and beyond what was even necessary/asked for. They even stacked the wood for me to use as firewood. I truly mean stacked as well. Not just thrown in a pile. The yard was clean and in great condition. They did an amazing job and I will absolutely use them again. No need to look elsewhere . It's hard to find somebody who has this kind of work ethic, capability, efficiency, etc this day and age. I can't recommend them highly enough.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Freeman
reviews.text: Reese is a true professional who knows his craft well. He provided a lot of guidance to help us get the most from his company's time on our property. He and his crew worked quickly and got a tremendous amount of work done while they were here. Everything was left very clean. Highly recommend this company!

reviews.author: Nikki W
reviews.text: We just had 2 days worth of tree work done on our property and we couldn't be happier. We had trees removed, dead limbs cut, canopies raised and all done at a very competitive price. The guys were on time both days and were courteous and respectful while here. Not only did they do great work, but the clean up at the end was above and beyond. I had 5 quotes done for this job from 5 different tree companies and I am so glad I decided to go with Masters Touch.

reviews.author: John Christman
reviews.text: I don't have enough good things to say about Reese, the owner/operator of Master's Touch. His reputation is impeccable and the people I know who have done business with him are highly satisfied as am I. I've recently had work done on my car and on my house and I can say that craftsmanship and pride in one's trade is dead! Not with Reese! Reese is truly a craftsman of yesteryear who takes great pride in his work. You just don't see this level of attention to detail and pride anymore. Period. Masters Touch is much more than a tree removal service. Reese has an artist's view of trees and will visualize what needs to be done and then skillfully perfect the trimming. The work he did for me was impeccable. Honestly he went above and beyond what I asked for and when he was finished there wasn't a stray leaf on the ground - everything was simply taken care of! I loved that his professionalism shone and I didn't have to do any hand holding at all - the work was simply done - and done expertly. I can't recommend Masters Touch enough and I really would recommend him to anyone.

reviews.author: Sarah Overstreet
reviews.text: Reese was an absolute life saver. We bit off more than we could chew with a DIY tree removal. When things were not looking great, I gave him a call. He was at our home in 20 minutes and saved the day. We would recommend master touch tree service to everyone after this amazing experience!

reviews.author: Jace Crockett
reviews.text: Amazing work by Reece and James. Removed a dead Hemlock, stray Magnolia, trimmed Pines, and cleaned up 2 huge Oaks that now look absolutely amazing! The clean up, cutting extra wood for firewood, last second ad on requests, all handled with class. And of course, you have to love seeing Reece climbing all through those huge Oaks, staying up there all day, and having lunch at 75 feet up. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Walter-Helen Alpaugh
reviews.text: We have only the best to say about Reece, Tammy, and their team. We had 20 or so trees removed, along with other clean-up work, and we couldn't have asked for a better experience. We were amazed that they were able to do so much work in a short time frame. Even our neighbors noticed that the work area looked so neat it was as though they were never here. The work done went above and beyond what we hoped for. Thanks so much to Tammy for her timely return of phone calls and to Reece and the crew for an impeccable job. This is truly a professional team. There is no doubt that we would use their services again.

reviews.author: Terry Metzgar
reviews.text: Professional, polite, competent, and amazing to watch. I've had Reece and his crew work at our place four times and each time have enjoyed the same good experience. I'd highly recommend them to anyone needing tree service.

reviews.author: Brian Tolley
reviews.text: Not a review guy, but needed to say something about this local company. Had a mess of trees that were eating my driveway. Called these folks and I can't tell you how impressed I am with there service and work. They worked their butts off in 20- 40 degree temps and completed the job in one day. This was not expected due to the enormity of the job, but a testament to their work ethic and saving me money. Other than the trees gone, everything was as before. Literally no mess. Can't go wrong with Reece and his crew,

reviews.author: Margaret Weidner
reviews.text: Reece and James are the hardest workers I've ever met! They did a super job on our acre lot, cleaned up things I didn't know needed trimming. It looks like we've had our house re-landscaped! Everything I asked for and more were taken care of and the clean-up job was immaculate.

reviews.author: Judith Ryon
reviews.text: Masters Touch Tree Service is the very best. Reece, the owner, is on the job and works with one other person. He discusses the job with you and does what he says he will do and charges what he says he and you agreed to. No surprises! He doesn't just cut limbs, he shapes your tree. He goes above and beyond expectations. He was a dream to work with.

reviews.author: John Macdonald
reviews.text: I called Reese because I grew up in Lynchburg and had always seen him around so I figured it would be worth giving him a call. We had a great conversation and seemed like a very genuine person and I felt like he understood what I was looking to accomplish. He came out and did exactly what I had requested, but then he actually had given me a couple recommendations that he thought would make a big difference and wouldn’t take too much longer. I told him to proceed and I can’t believe how he transformed my yard. Truly I am blown away. The other gentleman he had working with him was also a pleasure to work with. I very rarely fill out any kind of review, but this was so good I felt like I needed to share my appreciation.

reviews.author: Melinda Newsom
reviews.text: Extremely impressed by the Master's Touch tree service. Reece and his team were punctual, reliable safe and amazingly tidy. They over delivered on their promise and we couldn't be more pleased. I won't use any other tree service. We had zero clean up to do when they were finished and our yard is ready to be played in. Thank you, gentlemen!

reviews.author: Graham Stephens
reviews.text: These guys are the real deal!!! My wife and I met him to discuss a job at one of our properties. Reece spent a significant amount of time with us, evaluated our needs, and then actually suggested remediation which didn't involve any work for him! In other words, he was honest enough not to take our money for what he considered to be a unnecessary job! In addition to being impressed with his knowledge of his subject mater, we can vouch for Reece's honesty and will be using him in the future.

reviews.author: Craig Tuggle
reviews.text: This company is amazing! We had extensive tornado damage behind our house. Reese and crew came and removed all of the downed trees and it looks better now than it did before the tornado. Excellent company and excellent people. I highly recommend Master’s Touch Tree Services.

reviews.author: John Young
reviews.text: Reece and his guys spent the past two days at my house removing about 10 trees total and cleaning up another 5 or 6, including a huge post oak. All three of the guys are very knowledgeable and polite. No smoking on the job. No radios blasting. No cursing. They showed up, did the job well, and then cleaned up. The place looks great. Couldn't be happier.

reviews.author: Vicki Johnson
reviews.text: The Master's Touch did a splendid job on our trees. Clean up was done as the work progressed. Firewood was neatly stacked beside our house, the perfect length and ready to split. I would definitely use them again and I heartily recommend them.

reviews.author: Sylvia Frejd
reviews.text: Reece and his team did such a great job clearing trees and trimming them back for us to see our lake. They exceeded all our expectations. He was so knowledge about the different types of trees and also on how to keep them healthy. We highly recommend him!

reviews.author: Tina Collins
reviews.text: I am amazed at how well my yard looks now. Reece and his team removed several trees and cleaned several trees up. Very kind, honest, and extremely hard-working men! I would definitely call on them again with no hesitations. Thank you all very much.

reviews.author: Pizza The Hut
reviews.text: Super professional, did an amazing job. We will be calling them back for a few more trees. Very easy to talk to, and very polite. Extremely knowledgeable in what they do. Great rates which is always important. Can't say enough about our experience with them.

reviews.author: Bill Ragland
reviews.text: This company does excellent work at a reasonable price. They worked with professionalism and when the job was finished they cleaned up the work area as if they had never been there. I will use them again and I recommend this company to anyone who needs a professional job done. Thank you Reese a great job.

reviews.author: Virginia Towerman
reviews.text: Excellent work by true tree professionals. More than happy with the level of service, the advice we received and a fair price for the work. I will definitely use them again for future tree service.

reviews.author: Lynda Silvey
reviews.text: The Master's Touch Tree Service did a wonderful job! They had a hardworking, efficient crew and took care of our trees as if they were their own! I would certainly hire them again!

reviews.author: Levon Hooper
reviews.text: I used Masters Touch Tree Service to get dead limbs and sucker's from 4 trees. I am very pleased with their work and they did a fantastic job and left no mess. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: David Garner
reviews.text: These guys do great work. They cut and stacked the wood neatly and didn’t leave a mess. The owner is a great guy and I hated leaving a bad review. I left a bad review because of a misunderstanding. Not anyone’s fault but the owner made it right and that says a lot about his character and his commitment to customer service. I’ll be using these guys again in the future.

reviews.author: Jimmy Thompson
reviews.text: VERY HAPPY WITH THEIR WORK , THEY WERE VERY FAST, SAFE AND DID THE JOB TO 100 % SATISFACTION. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS CREW!

reviews.author: Diane Hobbs
reviews.text: Reese and his team recently took down three trees for me. One of the trees was quite a challenge as it was a large oak situated narrowly between electrical wires and my house. It was amazing to watch them work with such precision! They arrived early each morning and worked hard all day. They really know what they are doing. I was also very impressed with the cleanup, you’d barely know they were here except for the missing trees! Reese does what he says he'll do. Highly recommend Masters Touch Tree Service for any tree removal needs.

reviews.author: Christy Masters
reviews.text: We hired Reece and his crew from Masters Touch Tree Service for tree removal and pruning and we couldn't be happier. Reece was quick to respond to my calls and texts. He was able to do the job in a timely manner, did thorough work, and cleaned up so well you would never know a crew had been there. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: John Franklin
reviews.text: Reece Kincaid and his team did a beautiful remake of our back yard, removing two overgrown crepe myrtles and trimming back a large spruce to open up a beautiful landscape at a reasonable price!
